title: [Master]-Bug 641503 Financial Reporting - Duplicate Rows in Financial Report Excel Export After Adding GL Budget Dimension
summary: The export of account schedules to Excel no longer produces duplicate rows when a GL budget dimension has been added to the report.
key_points: Resolves duplicate rows appearing in financial report Excel exports
Fixes issue that occurred after adding GL budget dimensions
Updates export logic in the account schedule export report
Adds test coverage for the GL budget dimension scenario
Affects both base application and regional layers
